      "text": "Here is the translation of the Ci-en article.\n\n***\n\n**Progress Report (2025/12/05)**\n\nHello, this is Poring.\nI will report on the current progress.\n\n**■ Next Work**\n\nRight now, I am organizing the game system.\nRecently, I have been playing *Escape from Tarkov* and *Dark and Darker* (Dakkofu), and various new ideas have come up.\n\n*Tarkov* is essentially the ancestor of this genre. While I used to mainly watch others play, I generally understand the mechanics that serve as the core of this genre.\n*Dark and Darker* simplified *Tarkov* and put it into a PvE format.\nI think there is a lot to learn from *Dark and Darker* as well. The reason is that I feel *Dark and Darker* simplified the time-consuming parts while keeping only the true essence of *Tarkov*.\n\nAnyway, these two games gave me a lot of ideas. This is probably why various games have gradually introduced *Tarkov*-like mechanics.\nThe stimulation of winning in a high-risk, high-return environment is certainly irresistible.\nThe large number of equipment items can also stimulate the player\u0027s desire to hunt for treasure.\nBy combining content like missions and base building, even plain items can become desirable goods, and whether the exploration result is good or bad, there is always some harvest every time.\nThis is the attractive aspect I observed after playing these games recently.\n\nHowever, as an *eroge* (erotic game), if it uses turn-based battles, more adjustments are necessary.\nThere must be a core mechanism, but it also needs to satisfy the player\u0027s thirst in a short amount of time.\nHow to balance these two is the challenge for the next work.\n\nTo satisfy the player\u0027s desire for exploration, I have already created over 100 types of weapons and items. However, I think I will probably outsource the item images.\nBecause I am drawing the erotic parts.\n\n**DLsite 2024 Overseas Award Silver Prize**\nThank you everyone!\nI didn\u0027t know about it while the voting was happening...\nThank you so much!\n\n**Red Goat**\nThe combination of a demon and a suit went better than I thought.\n\n**Bat Girl Set**\nThey are all masterpieces!\n\n**Iron Maiden**\nEver since *Castle*, whether as an enemy or a trap, I\u0027ve always wanted to put an Iron Maiden in the game.\nHowever, with the initial design, it was difficult to do erotic things to a male character.\nBut, I created this character based on ideas from other characters.\nPlease rest assured that she will do erotic things to the player.\n\n**■ Vampire Survivor**\n\nTo give the conclusion first, I am continuing to ask the programmer for work.\nI feel the progress is still a little lacking, but...\nOnce the title, menu, and other screens were applied, the level of polish properly increased.\nThough the game itself is still incomplete.\nA Demo version within this year is impossible, yes.\n\nRecently, I spent time on game mechanics, so I haven\u0027t drawn much.\nThe next time we meet will be next year. So, let me say this in advance: Merry Christmas, and have a Happy New Year!",
